question: What is the dumbest lie you told that completely spiraled out of control?
story: In seventh grade, I told everyone I was allergic to the sun, and I kept that lie alive for four years. It started because I didn't want to do field day. One little lie. I have a sun allergy. But my school took it SERIOUSLY. They moved me inside during assemblies. Teachers closed blinds when I walked in. A girl I liked called me a vampire, and honestly, it boosted my mystique. But the lie grew hungry. My mom got called in, and instead of busting me, she PLAYED ALONG, because she didn't want to look like a bad parent. We saw a doctor who found nothing and called it a rare sensitivity. By senior year, the school built shade structures. Real construction. With a budget. On graduation day, they gave me a special tent. I sat under it, in the shade, knowing I built that tent with lies.
